''See also: [[Blackwatch Guild Head Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] is the current leader of the Blackwatch{{!}}Blackwatch Guild, an organization established by the Emperor to utilize and study the power of the [[Elders]] for the benefit of humanity. As [[Guild]] Head, she possesses significant [[Authority|authority]], including the power to oversee members personally and the ability to bypass standard recruitment procedures. She is described as a formidable and unpredictable figure, often regarded as terrifying by others. Her role involves high-stakes responsibilities such as managing the [[Guild]]'s disciplined, regimented members and overseeing operations related to [[Elders]] and their artifacts. In some traditions, [[Guild Heads]] are elected based on their ability to bond with specific historical vessels. [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] is a powerful [[Soulbound]] and stands as one of the most influential leaders among the [[Imperialist Guilds]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Guild]] Head has met with [[Regent|Regent Loreli]]. Additionally, the leader of the [[Blackwatch]] is known to have fought a [[Regent]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Blackwatch|Blackwatch Guild]] Head is a terrifying young woman characterized by her long, silver-toned blond hair. While she can be found drinking [[tea]], she is often seen wearing a long black coat adorned with silver buttons. As the leader of her organization, she is known to issue various whims.}}
